No, just a ruling. We're you thinking of something specific?

Blood Rage - Combat (tha)
* Blood Rage doesn't protect the target from taking damage from his own
strike, since "inflict" has been ruled to mean "inflict on the opposing
minion/retainer". So side-effect damage from a Bomb, Zip Gun, etc. is
unaffected by Blood Rage. [LSJ 16-FEB-1998]
* Requires thaumaturgy, not fortitude. [Card]
